page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2c.24xlarge is a dedicated big data server instance optimized for massive local storage capacity and parallel data processing. Powered by 96 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine runs on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 352.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.67 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It does not include GPU acceleration.

A defining characteristic of this configuration is its integrated dense storage layer, providing 47674 GB of local HDD storage directly bundled with the host. This spinning disk array prioritizes raw capacity for high-throughput sequential data operations, representing a distinct architectural tradeoff compared to low-latency, high-IOPS NVMe SSD configurations. High-speed host connectivity is supported through a baseline network bandwidth of 35 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer across distributed clusters.

The high disk density paired with balanced compute and memory capacity makes the ecs.d2c.24xlarge well suited for distributed data storage and analytics platforms. Primary workload applications include Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark, distributed file systems, data warehousing, map-reduce batch operations, and large-scale log aggregation clusters where cost-effective bulk retention and sequential streaming access are prioritized over sub-millisecond random I/O.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2c.24xlarge is a big data instance built for capacity-intensive distributed applications and large-scale analytical processing. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture, managed via KVM virtualization. The system is provisioned with 352.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.67 GB per virtual core. Storage is provided by a substantial 47674 GB local HDD configuration, delivering dense capacity for high-volume data retention without requiring external block devices. Host networking provides a baseline throughput of 35 Gbps, facilitating rapid cluster-wide data synchronization and node communication. The trade-off between massive mechanical HDD volume and random access latency aligns the instance with batch-oriented big data environments. Consequently, the ecs.d2c.24xlarge is designed for distributed computing platforms such as Hadoop, Spark, bulk data lakes, MapReduce batch jobs, and distributed log processing frameworks requiring high disk volume per compute node.
